subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Golden Ratio
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Golden Ratio.

hook.text: 1.618—the golden ratio appears in sunflower spirals, seashells, and the Parthenon. Nature loves this number.

buildup.text: The ratio describes a proportion where the whole relates to the larger part as the larger relates to the smaller.

discovery.text: Renaissance artists used it deliberately. Da Vinci's Vitruvian Man is built on golden proportions.

twist.text: Some claims are exaggerated. The Great Pyramid doesn't perfectly encode it. But the myth of the ratio persists.

climax.text: The golden ratio sits between math and myth. It appears often enough in nature to feel divine, but not reliably.

punchline.text: Nature hints at a number. We made it sacred.

quiz.question: What is the approximate value of the golden ratio?
